findings.title: Default strategy test deployment omits required rolling-updates flag
findings.body: In UpgradeTest.createInitialDeployment the method returns early when updateStrategy is null without enabling the rolling-updates feature, while the non-null path enables it via FeatureSpec. The operator docs in this same PR state the feature must be enabled otherwise the Operator will fail. Consequence: the parameterized runs with null strategy deploy a Keycloak CR without the required flag, so reconciliation will fail or will test different behavior than documented, invalidating testImageChange and testCacheMaxCount for the default strategy.

findings.title: Test helper overwrites enabled features instead of appending
findings.body: In UpgradeTest.createInitialDeployment the code calls setEnabledFeatures(List.of(rolling-updates key)). That replaces the entire enabled-features list coming from getTestKeycloakDeployment instead of adding to it. Consequence: any features already enabled on the base deployment are silently dropped, so the test runs with the wrong feature set and can false-pass or false-fail.

findings.title: Feature gate only tested for metadata and exit codes never asserted
findings.body: UpdateCommandDistTest adds testFeatureNotEnabled only for update-compatibility metadata, with no equivalent test for the check subcommand which has the same gate in UpdateCompatibilityCheck. It also only asserts stderr text and never asserts exit code 4 for disabled feature, and testWrongVersions never asserts exit code 3 for recreate. This PR changes RECREATE exit from 4 to 3 and adds 4 for FEATURE_DISABLED, and automation relies on those codes. Consequence: a missing gate on check or a wrong exit code regression would not be caught by tests.
